This plot is small and rented, so I will try to keep my costs low and use what I can manage with my household. Here in the South East, for root crops, I am more likely to rely on local planting material and some compost or manure if I can get it, because fertilizer and chemicals are costly and not always easy to buy. I will not irrigate because we depend on the rains, but I expect to spend a good amount of family labor on land preparation, planting, weeding, and harvesting, and I may still hire a few laborers when the work is heavy.
